tools.name: preserve_attempt
tools.description: Attempt one restored-film deposit through the managed Film Preservation Desk. Returns a preservation result or a native error result carrying the service's exact refusal notice. Call exactly once per job.

tools.name: preserve_report
tools.description: Record the observed outcome of one attempted film-preservation job and return its single-use report receipt. Use an empty system_message only when preservation completed or a complete refusal notice was unavailable.
